title: K-flat criteria
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring and $T$ a scheme. Work on a small skeleton of $T_{\Et}$ in the chosen universe [def-weil-pbc-etale-site; def-weil-size-convention], with the constant ring sheaf $\Lambda_T$ [def-kun-constant-sheaf]. Complexes and K-flatness use the direct-sum total tensor convention of [def-kun-derived-tensor]; flat sheaves mean tensor-flat sheaves [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules].

(1) Every bounded-above complex of flat $\Lambda_T$-module sheaves is K-flat.

(2) In a distinguished triangle in the homotopy category $K(\operatorname{Mod}(\Lambda_T))$ (complexes modulo chain homotopy, with distinguished triangles the triangles isomorphic to mapping-cone triangles [lem-pur-homotopy-category-triangulated]), if two terms are K-flat, so is the third. In particular, the cone of a morphism between K-flat complexes is K-flat.

(3) For every small filtered category $I$ and diagram $(K_i^\bullet)_{i\in I}$ of K-flat complexes, the degreewise sheaf colimit $\varinjlim_i K_i^\bullet$ is K-flat. In particular, a complex expressed as a small filtered degreewise colimit of bounded-above complexes of flat sheaves is K-flat.

proof.text: Set R to the constant coefficient ring sheaf on the small etale site. Given an upper bound b, CochainComplex.isStrictlyLE_iff equips P with IsStrictlyLE b. Apply the proved independent-universe bounded-flat criterion [lem-weil-pbc-independent-bounded-flat-kflat] directly to the assumed IsFlatOnSite terms [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Its IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients conclusion is definitionally the existing IsAcyclicTensorKFlat predicate at these universes. No tensor-factor interchange or lower bound is required.

Use tensorPreadditive from the bounded-flat module and tensorLeft_preservesColimits_independentCoefficients from [lem-weil-pbc-independent-sheaf-tensor-colimits], shrinking preservation to countable diagrams to construct all unbounded direct-sum total tensor complexes [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. For each fixed complex A, the already-proved source-library bifunctorMapHomotopyCategory applied to curriedTensor descends total tensor to a functor G on the homotopy category; the IsTriangulated instance of WeilConjectures.FromJoel.Algebra.Homology.BifunctorTriangulated gives G.map_distinguished. These instances use the cone comparison and signed tensor homotopies, so no separate cone/homotopy calculation is needed in this item.

proof.text: Let P be HomotopyCategory.subcategoryAcyclic. For each of the three representative isomorphisms e_j, P.prop_iff_of_iso (G.mapIso e_j), followed by quotient_obj_mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff_acyclic, identifies P(G(Delta.obj_j)) with acyclicity of Tot(A tensor K_j). Apply P.ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed_3, _2 and _1 to G.map_distinguished Delta hDelta. Quantify over acyclic A to obtain all three K-flat implications. Specializing this result to mappingCone.triangleh f, using mappingCone_triangleh_distinguished and the identity isomorphisms, proves the explicit cone corollary.

For a small filtered category I, exactness of I-colimits of abelian groups passes to abelian sheaves by Mathlib CategoryTheory.Sheaf.hasExactColimitsOfShape, then to R-module sheaves by HasExactColimitsOfShape.domain_of_functor applied to SheafOfModules.toSheaf. The source-library preservesColimitsOfShape_toSheaf instance follows from module sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Tensor-colimit preservation [lem-weil-pbc-independent-sheaf-tensor-colimits] and the source BifunctorColimits instances show that total tensor G with a fixed A preserves I-colimits.

proof.text: Prove acyclic_colimit for any abelian category with exact I-colimits. In degree n, form in the functor category I to D the short complex S of differentials in degrees n-1,n,n+1. ShortComplex.functorEquivalence constructs S from the diagram of degree-n short complexes. Pointwise acyclicity makes S exact: exact_iff_isZero_homology, Functor.isZero_iff, and S.mapHomologyIso for each evaluation give this directly. Apply colim.exact_mapShortComplex to S, the colimit cocones preserved by each of the three HomologicalComplex.eval functors, and the commutation equations of colimit. This makes the colimit complex exact in degree n. Apply this helper to F followed by total tensor G: every diagram term is acyclic by the assumed K-flatness. Transfer along (preservesColimitIso G F).symm to show tensoring colimit F with A is acyclic. Quantifying over A proves filtered-colimit K-flatness. Finally apply the bounded-flat clause termwise to prove the last corollary; each term may have its own upper bound.

theorem etale_kflat_criteria (T : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] :
    (∀ P : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
        ((sheafCompose T.smallEtaleTopology
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
          ((constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
            (CommRingCat.of Λ)))) ℤ,
      (∃ b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, b < n → IsZero (P.X n)) →
      (∀ n : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite (J := T.smallEtaleTopology) (R :=
        (constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (CommRingCat.of Λ)) (P.X n)) →
      CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R :=
        (constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (CommRingCat.of Λ)) P) ∧
    (∀ (Δ : Triangle (HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
        ((sheafCompose T.smallEtaleTopology
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
          ((constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
            (CommRingCat.of Λ)))) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
      (K₁ K₂ K₃ : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
        ((sheafCompose T.smallEtaleTopology
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
          ((constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
            (CommRingCat.of Λ)))) ℤ),
      Δ ∈ distTriang (HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
        ((sheafCompose T.smallEtaleTopology
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
          ((constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
            (CommRingCat.of Λ)))) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) →
      Nonempty (Δ.obj₁ ≅ (HomotopyCategory.quotient (SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
        ((sheafCompose T.smallEtaleTopology
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
          ((constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
            (CommRingCat.of Λ)))) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K₁) →
      Nonempty (Δ.obj₂ ≅ (HomotopyCategory.quotient (SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
        ((sheafCompose T.smallEtaleTopology
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
          ((constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
            (CommRingCat.of Λ)))) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K₂) →
      Nonempty (Δ.obj₃ ≅ (HomotopyCategory.quotient (SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
        ((sheafCompose T.smallEtaleTopology
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
          ((constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
            (CommRingCat.of Λ)))) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K₃) →
      (CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R :=
        (constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (CommRingCat.of Λ)) K₁ ∧ CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R :=
        (constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (CommRingCat.of Λ)) K₂ →
        CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R :=
        (constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (CommRingCat.of Λ)) K₃) ∧
      (CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R :=
        (constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (CommRingCat.of Λ)) K₁ ∧ CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R :=
        (constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (CommRingCat.of Λ)) K₃ →
        CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R :=
        (constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (CommRingCat.of Λ)) K₂) ∧
      (CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R :=
        (constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (CommRingCat.of Λ)) K₂ ∧ CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R :=
        (constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (CommRingCat.of Λ)) K₃ →
        CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R :=
        (constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (CommRingCat.of Λ)) K₁)) ∧
    (∀ (K₁ K₂ : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
        ((sheafCompose T.smallEtaleTopology
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
          ((constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
            (CommRingCat.of Λ)))) ℤ) (f : K₁ ⟶ K₂),
      CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R :=
        (constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (CommRingCat.of Λ)) K₁ → CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R :=
        (constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (CommRingCat.of Λ)) K₂ →
      CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R :=
        (constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (CommRingCat.of Λ)) (CochainComplex.mappingCone f)) ∧
    (∀ (I : Type (u + 1)) [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
      (F : I ⥤ CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
        ((sheafCompose T.smallEtaleTopology
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
          ((constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
            (CommRingCat.of Λ)))) ℤ),
      (∀ i : I, CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R :=
        (constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (CommRingCat.of Λ)) (F.obj i)) →
      CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R :=
        (constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (CommRingCat.of Λ)) (colimit F)) ∧
    (∀ (I : Type (u + 1)) [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
      (F : I ⥤ CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
        ((sheafCompose T.smallEtaleTopology
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
          ((constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
            (CommRingCat.of Λ)))) ℤ),
      (∀ i : I, (∃ b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, b < n → IsZero ((F.obj i).X n)) ∧
        ∀ n : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite (J := T.smallEtaleTopology) (R :=
        (constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (CommRingCat.of Λ)) ((F.obj i).X n)) →
      CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R :=
        (constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (CommRingCat.of Λ)) (colimit F))
